text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=canary-health-check severity=critical. Summary: spike in 5xx for canary region eu-west-1 (rolling release: sidecar v2.4.0). PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 created -> triggered -> escalation policy: infra-oncall. Initial trigger at 1767894320.

alex: saw this in grafana. canary error rate jumped from 0.2% to ~18% over last 2m. failing on inference sidecar: grpc 500s. tagging @maria oncall.

maria: ACK - joining. I'm pulling logs now.

sre_lead: good catch. is this limited to eu-west-1 canaries? any prod traffic?

maria: looks limited to canary pool. traffic split shows 5% to canary, but errors are high so some production requests are hitting fallback paths -> increased latency for a subset of users. product_oncall, heads up on potential customer impact.

product_oncall: copy. support_eng says ~12 customers reported 500s in last 5m. we're seeing increased error reports in support queue.

support_eng: confirmed, tickets 4521-4532 reference 500 during text generation. adding status page note draft.

maria: digging into sidecar logs. error stack points to serialization change in v2.4.0. reproducing locally now.

alex: if this is a regression from v2.4.0 we should rollback the sidecar on canary and pause rollout. recommend: 1) remove canary traffic 2) rollback sidecar image to v2.3.1 3) suppress noisy alerts.

maria: starting rollback on canary now.

# command

maria: ```bash
kubectl -n inference-canary set image deploy/sidecar sidecar=gcr.io/redwood/sidecar:v2.3.1
kubectl -n inference-canary rollout status deploy/sidecar --timeout=120s
```

deploy-bot: Rollout initiated for deploy/sidecar namespace=inference-canary image=gcr.io/redwood/sidecar:v2.3.1 by maria at 1767894380.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 acknowledged by maria at 1767894382.

maria: rollout completed, pods are ready. running canary healthcheck...

# healthcheck output

maria: ```
> curl -sS -I https://canary.eu-west-1.redwood.ai/health | head -n 1
HTTP/2 200
```

alex: error rate dropping back to baseline in graphs. starting to re-enable canary traffic slowly (0 -> 1% -> 5%) and monitoring.

deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: inference-service -> canary 1% at 1767894450; monitoring 60s windows.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: auto-escalation canceled (incident acknowledged).

product_oncall: I'm drafting a brief external status update: "We experienced elevated errors for a small subset of requests due to a canary-sidecar regression; rollback completed and service returning to normal; monitoring continues." Will post after you confirm.

maria: confirmed. go ahead and post.

support_eng: posted on status.redwood.ai: https://status.redwood.ai/incs/437 - linking customer tickets.

sre_lead: nice work. next: create a short postmortem + PR to revert the sidecar change in the rollout pipeline until we fix root cause. assign to maria + runtime team.

maria: will file postmortem and open a revert PR. joining bridge for 10m monitor: https://meet.redwood.ai/bridge/incident-PD12345

alex: I'll take 30m follow-up monitoring. @sre_lead, handing off primary watch.

maria: handing over to alex at 1767894540. I'm available for callbacks.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 resolved at 1767894590 (status: resolved) - resolution note: rolled back sidecar to v2.3.1 on canary, traffic throttled then restored, error rate returned to baseline.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed; create postmortem ticket and link it here when ready.

maria: filing postmortem now: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-2124 - short RCA: serialization change in sidecar v2.4.0 incompatible with older client behavior. mitigation: rollback, add integration test for serialization schema, pin canary until tests pass.

alex: adding monitoring alert tuning to avoid noisy pages for transient canary spikes.

sre_lead: thanks all. marking as handled. final note: follow through on test coverage and revert PR before next rollout. :white_check_mark:
